prompt: CSS flexbox main size depends on cross size auto indefinite substitute
answer:
When calculating a flex item’s **flex base size**, if the item’s main size depends on its cross size—such as when the main size is in the block axis—and the cross size is `auto` and **indefinite**, Flexbox substitutes `fit-content` for that cross size during the calculation. The resulting main size becomes the flex base size. [CSS Flexbox §9.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2016/CR-css-flexbox-1-20160526/)

If the item has an intrinsic aspect ratio, a `content` flex basis, and a **definite** cross size, the flex base size is instead calculated from the inner cross size and the aspect ratio. [CSS Flexbox §9.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2016/CR-css-flexbox-1-20160526/)
